resources.string: Osmo 360 RC is installed.\n\nReturn to osmodule, connect the Osmo 360, then tap Remote beside its status for controls and live preview.

Step 1 of 2 · Permissions belong to the Osmo 360 RC plugin APK, not to Base. Remote control uses Nearby devices/Bluetooth and Nearby Wi-Fi for local live preview. Location is also used by GPS sync; notifications are optional and only control whether its ongoing notification appears.
Step 2 of 2 · HyperOS also requires Autostart for Base to open this plugin reliably. Android does not expose this as a runtime permission, so confirm it manually in the system screen.
